Warm cream, sage, dusty rose and light walnut palette; adorable but tasteful, soft rounded forms, subtle hand-painted gouache and linen texture, fine warm brown outlines, front three-quarter view. One compact centered silhouette, generous transparent margin, readable at 40 pixels. No text, no letters, no border, no background, no cast shadow extending far outside. 1:1 composition. Fully transparent background.
